diagnostic_evidence.quote: \max_{0 \leq i \leq m} \mathbb{E}\Big( & \abs{Y_{t_{i}} - Y_{t_{i}}^{\pi, \theta}}^{2} \Big) +   \mathbb{E}\Big( \int_{0}^{T}  \abs{Z_{u} - Z_{u}^{\pi, \theta}}^{2}  du \Big)  \\ & \leq  C \Bigg( \abs{\pi}  + \mathbb{E}\big( \abs{\xi - \mathcal{C}^{\theta}(\xi)}^2) + \frac{\mathbb{E}(\norm{D \xi}_{\mathbb{H}_{T}}^{2})}{P+1} \Bigg)
Under Assumption \ref{assumption 1}, the random variable $\xi$ has absolute moments of fourth order, and hence $\mathbf{V}_{m}(\xi)$ can be proven to be finite.

issues.failure_explanation: Section 4.3 states that only Assumption 2.2 (`\ref{assumption 1}`) is assumed. However, Assumption 2.2 only provides $\xi \in L^2(\mathcal{F}_T)$ and Lipschitz continuity of $f$, whereas Theorem 4.8 relies on: (1) Theorem 2.4 to obtain the $O(|\pi|)$ discretization rate, which requires Assumption 2.4 (`\ref{main assumption convergence rate}`); (2) Lemma 4.4, which requires $f \in C_{b,(y,z)}^{1:1}$ and $\xi \in \mathbb{D}_T^{1,2}$; and (3) Malliavin differentiability of $\xi$ so that $\mathbb{E}(\|D\xi\|_{\mathbb{H}_T}^2)$ is defined. Furthermore, Theorem 4.9 requires $\mathbf{V}_m(\xi) < \infty$, which requires $\xi \in L^4$, whereas Remark 4.10 erroneously claims that Assumption 2.2 guarantees that $\xi$ has fourth moments (a property that actually comes from Assumption 2.4 where $\xi \in \mathbb{D}_T^{2,q}$ with $q > 4$).

failure_location.quote: Through this section we make use of the following notation and assumptions. Let $\pi \subset [0,T]$ be a partition such that $\max_{i} \Delta_i / \Delta_{i+1} \leq L$. Let $\theta = (P,M) \in \mathbb{N}^{2}$. Let Assumption \ref{assumption 1} be satisfied.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Change the preamble of Section 4.3 to assume Assumption 2.4 (`\ref{main assumption convergence rate}`) instead of Assumption 2.2 (`\ref{assumption 1}`), and update the cross-reference in Remark 4.10 accordingly.
issues.overall_effect: Theorems 4.8 and 4.9 do not hold under the stated hypothesis (Assumption 2.2). Their conclusions require the higher Malliavin regularity, higher integrability of $\xi$, and time-regularity of $f$ given in Assumption 2.4.
issues.title: Main error estimates assume basic $L^2$ BSDE existence conditions instead of Malliavin regularity conditions
issues.why_classification: Substituting Assumption 2.4 for Assumption 2.2 in Section 4.3 is a straightforward, local correction that provides all required hypotheses, fully preserves the advertised rates and convergence bounds, and requires no modification to the proof architecture.
